structured.answer: Harel has around 100 tracks plus a few קרנות מחקות/סל. The S&P 500 tracks cost about 0.5% a year and show roughly 13.7% for 3 years and 11.9% for 5, which is what I'd look at. But I don't know which product to go with or whether the 13.7% is per year, so I wouldn't act today.

stuck.why: Two fees, 'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדה'. In the pension sections the second one jumps to 1.47% / 1.14% and I don't get which one I'd actually pay
Most rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number. Couldn't tell if 13.7% is per year or total

stuck.where: קרנות מחקות / קרנות סל at the bottom
stuck.why: No return shown at all, and three fee lines (קבוע/משתנה/נאמן), so I can't compare them with the tracks above

findings.what: Every row repeats the same labels (מהחיסכון/מההפקדה, מניות/מט"ח, 3 שנים/5 שנים), so I had to re-read them all to find what changes
About 100 near-identical options and no hint which one fits a beginner. Made me want to do nothing
Most return cells say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number
The index funds show no performance, so I can't compare them with the tracks
Two fee lines per row with no explanation of which one I'd pay; the second goes up to 1.47%
Ring chart colours explained only by small dots next to the words
Reddish tag 'מס גם על שינויי המטבע' feels like a warning and scares me off those funds
